claims: On Tuesday, April 7, 2026, Wendy's is offering a free small Hot & Crispy Fry and a free small Chocolate or Vanilla Frosty to celebrate a slam dunk during the NCAA championship game.
The deal is available in-restaurant only at participating U.S. locations.
No purchase is necessary for the deal.
The promotion offers one free Small Hot & Crispy Fry.
The promotion offers one small chocolate or vanilla Frosty.
The promotion applies to in-restaurant orders.
The deal is available on a walk-in basis.
The "Free Dunks for America" offer is a direct result of the first dunk during the NCAA Men's Basketball National Championship game.
